failure_modes.name: Solver_Passage_Content_Misreading
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 states: 'Passage [2] explicitly states that locals consider Crafers to be a suburb of the nearby township of Stirling—the opposite of what the claim states.' This is a misreading. The claim states 'The locals consider the township of Stirling a suburb of a town,' which means Stirling is considered a suburb OF ANOTHER TOWN (not that other places are suburbs of Stirling). Passage [2] from hop 1 ('locals consider Crafers to be more a suburb of the nearby township of Stirling') shows Stirling is the larger township, contradicting the claim's assertion that Stirling itself is a suburb. The solver incorrectly claims the relationship is 'reversed' when in fact the passage refutes the claim directly.
